draft_schema.reason: Draft wrapper and referenced payload schemas only; full-record root constraints are not checked.

follow_up_operations.reason: Registered agent/operation pairing only; required operation inputs remain scheduler work.

task_contract.reason: Existing Contracts.task checks, restricted to paper.extract.

task_output_types.reason: Every output family must be declared. Missing families are reported, not treated as a Result outcome.

task_record_refs.reason: All nested references, including follow-up requests; artifact path_hint is not identity. Actual visibility is not checked.

task_artifact_refs.reason: All nested references, including follow-up requests; artifact path_hint is not identity. Actual visibility is not checked.

record_shape_and_hash.reason: Drafts have no business envelope or record hash.

paper_lint.reason: Only the listed Paper filling rules; structurally invalid records are skipped. No semantic judgment.

record_set.reason: No RecordSet validation, reference closure or cross-record checks.

source_bytes.reason: No source bytes are opened or verified; catalog membership is not provenance proof.

execution_identity.reason: Actual visibility, producer identity and independent review require the host.

delivery.reason: A draft is not a Result; missing output families and open items do not determine outcome.

scientific_correctness.reason: No semantic inference, claim merging or scientific assessment.
